description: Read a plain Markdown file (e.g. 260321_openclawConfig.md), generate header and section images using the default OpenClaw image model and API key from ~/openclaw/.env, create a new *_img.md copy with embedded PNGs, and move all generated images into an img/ folder next to the original file.
